# aegov-dls-angular

> Unofficial, community-driven Angular 19+ port of the UAE Government Design Language System (AEGOV DLS). Built with Standalone Components, Angular Signals, modern control flow (@if, @for), Tailwind CSS v4, and Phosphor Icons.

## Setup & Global Requirements

1. **Installation**:
```bash
npm install aegov-dls-angular @angular/cdk
```

2. **Global Stylesheet**:
Must include the compiled Tailwind v4 CSS in the global stylesheet (`styles.css` or `angular.json`):
```css
@import "aegov-dls-angular/styles/tailwind.css";
```

3. **Standalone Component Import**:
Import components directly from `'aegov-dls-angular'`:
```typescript
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { ButtonComponent, InputComponent, AlertComponent, IconComponent } from 'aegov-dls-angular';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-example',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ButtonComponent, InputComponent, AlertComponent, IconComponent],
  template: `...`
})
export class ExampleComponent {}
```

---

## Component Index & Quick Reference

### 1. Button (`ae-button`, `button[ae-button]`, `a[ae-button]`)
- **Import**: `import { ButtonComponent } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `color`: `'primary' | 'secondary'` (default: `'primary'`)
  - `variant`: `'solid' | 'soft' | 'link' | 'outline' | 'outline-solid'` (default: `'solid'`)
  - `size`: `'xs' | 'sm' | 'base' | 'lg'` (default: `'base'`)
  - `block`: `boolean` (full width)
  - `disabled`: `boolean`
  - `isIcon`: `boolean` (for square icon buttons)
  - `href`: `string` (renders `<a>` tag when set)
  - `type`: `'button' | 'submit' | 'reset'` (default: `'button'`)
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-button color="primary" variant="solid" size="base">
  Submit Application
</ae-button>
<a ae-button href="/portal" color="secondary" variant="outline">
  Go to Portal
</a>
```

### 2. Icon (`ae-icon`) & Custom Icons
- **Import**: `import { IconComponent, provideAeIcons, AeIconRegistry } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `name`: `string` (e.g. `'check'`, `'x'`, `'caret-down'`, `'warning'`, `'info'`, `'check-circle'`, `'house'`, or any custom icon registered via `provideAeIcons`)
  - `svg`: `string` (direct SVG path content e.g. `[svg]="customSvgString"`)
  - `weight`: `'regular' | 'bold' | 'fill' | 'light' | 'thin' | 'duotone'` (default: `'regular'`)
  - `size`: `number | string` (default: `16`)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Register Custom / Consumer Icons** (in `app.config.ts` or component):
```typescript
import { provideAeIcons } from 'aegov-dls-angular';

export const appConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideAeIcons({
      heart: '<path d="..."/>',
      gear: '<path d="..."/>',
    }),
  ],
};
```
- **Usage**:
```html
<!-- Built-in icons work with zero configuration -->
<ae-icon name="check" [size]="20" class="text-primary-600"></ae-icon>
<ae-icon name="caret-down" weight="bold" [size]="16"></ae-icon>

<!-- Registered custom icons -->
<ae-icon name="heart" [size]="24" class="text-red-500"></ae-icon>

<!-- Direct SVG string -->
<ae-icon [svg]="customSvg" [size]="24"></ae-icon>
```

### 3. Input (`ae-input`)
- **Import**: `import { InputComponent } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Features**: `ControlValueAccessor` compatible with `[(ngModel)]` and `[formControl]`.
- **Inputs**:
  - `type`: `'text' | 'password' | 'email' | 'number' | 'search' | 'tel' | 'url'` (default: `'text'`)
  - `label`: `string`
  - `placeholder`: `string`
  - `helperText`: `string`
  - `error`: `string` (shows validation error text & red border)
  - `size`: `'sm' | 'base' | 'lg'` (default: `'base'`)
  - `variant`: `'primary' | 'secondary'` (default: `'primary'`)
  - `disabled`: `boolean`
  - `required`: `boolean`
- **Slots**: `[prefix]`, `[suffix]`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-input
  label="Emirates ID"
  placeholder="784-XXXX-XXXXXXX-X"
  [(ngModel)]="emiratesId"
  [required]="true"
  helperText="Enter 15 digit Emirates ID">
</ae-input>
```

### 4. Textarea (`ae-textarea`)
- **Import**: `import { TextareaComponent } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `label`: `string`
  - `placeholder`: `string`
  - `rows`: `number` (default: `4`)
  - `error`: `string`
  - `helperText`: `string`
  - `disabled`: `boolean`
  - `required`: `boolean`
  - `size`: `'sm' | 'base' | 'lg'`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-textarea
  label="Feedback / Comments"
  placeholder="Write your comments here..."
  [(ngModel)]="comments"
  [rows]="5">
</ae-textarea>
```

### 5. Select (`ae-select`)
- **Import**: `import { SelectComponent, SelectOption } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `options`: `SelectOption[]` (`{ value: string, label: string, disabled?: boolean }`)
  - `label`: `string`
  - `placeholder`: `string`
  - `error`: `string`
  - `helperText`: `string`
  - `size`: `'sm' | 'base' | 'lg'`
  - `disabled`: `boolean`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-select
  label="Select Emirate"
  [options]="[
    { value: 'auh', label: 'Abu Dhabi' },
    { value: 'dxb', label: 'Dubai' },
    { value: 'shj', label: 'Sharjah' }
  ]"
  [(ngModel)]="selectedEmirate">
</ae-select>
```

### 6. Alert (`ae-alert`)
- **Import**: `import { AlertComponent } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `variant`: `'info' | 'warning' | 'success' | 'error'` (default: `'info'`)
  - `tone`: `'soft' | 'solid'` (default: `'soft'`)
  - `size`: `'sm' | 'base' | 'lg'` (default: `'base'`)
  - `title`: `string`
  - `dismissible`: `boolean`
  - `showIcon`: `boolean` (default: `true`)
  - `action`: `{ text: string, href: string }`
- **Outputs**: `(dismiss)`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-alert variant="success" title="Application Approved" [dismissible]="true">
  Your digital permit has been issued successfully.
</ae-alert>
```

### 7. Modal (`ae-modal`)
- **Import**: `import { ModalComponent } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `open`: `boolean` (controlled visibility)
  - `title`: `string`
  - `size`: `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl'` (default: `'md'`)
  - `variant`: `'default' | 'danger'`
  - `closeOnBackdrop`: `boolean` (default: `true`)
  - `closeOnEsc`: `boolean` (default: `true`)
- **Outputs**: `(close)`
- **Slots**: `[trigger]`, default `<ng-content>`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-modal [open]="isModalOpen" (close)="isModalOpen = false" title="Confirm Action">
  <p class="text-gray-600 mb-6">Are you sure you want to proceed with this request?</p>
  <div class="flex justify-end gap-3">
    <ae-button variant="outline" color="secondary" (click)="isModalOpen = false">Cancel</ae-button>
    <ae-button color="primary" (click)="confirmAction()">Confirm</ae-button>
  </div>
</ae-modal>
```

### 8. Toast (`ae-toast`, `ToastService`)
- **Import**: `import { ToastComponent, ToastService } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Service API**:
  - `toastService.success(message, title?)`
  - `toastService.error(message, title?)`
  - `toastService.info(message, title?)`
  - `toastService.warning(message, title?)`
  - `toastService.show({ message, title, variant, duration })`
- **App Setup**: Place `<ae-toast></ae-toast>` once in `app.component.html`.
- **Usage**:
```typescript
import { Component, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { ToastComponent, ToastService, ButtonComponent } from 'aegov-dls-angular';

@Component({
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ToastComponent, ButtonComponent],
  template: `
    <ae-button (click)="notify()">Notify</ae-button>
    <ae-toast></ae-toast>
  `
})
export class AppComponent {
  private toast = inject(ToastService);

  notify() {
    this.toast.success('Document uploaded successfully!', 'Upload Complete');
  }
}
```

### 9. Tabs (`ae-tabs`)
- **Import**: `import { TabsComponent, TabItem } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `items`: `TabItem[]` (`{ value: string, label: string, content?: string, icon?: IconName }`)
  - `variant`: `'default' | 'pills' | 'compact'`
  - `defaultValue`: `string`
- **Outputs**: `(tabChange)`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-tabs
  variant="pills"
  [items]="[
    { value: 'personal', label: 'Personal Info', content: 'Personal details form' },
    { value: 'documents', label: 'Documents', content: 'Uploaded documents list' }
  ]">
</ae-tabs>
```

### 10. Accordion (`ae-accordion`, `ae-accordion-item`)
- **Import**: `import { AccordionComponent, AccordionItemComponent } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs on `ae-accordion`**:
  - `type`: `'single' | 'multiple'` (default: `'single'`)
  - `variant`: `'default' | 'card' | 'bordered'`
  - `items`: `AccordionItemData[]` (optional data-driven mode)
- **Inputs on `ae-accordion-item`**:
  - `value`: `string` (required)
  - `title`: `string` (required)
  - `icon`: `IconName` (default: `'caret-down'`)
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-accordion type="single">
  <ae-accordion-item value="item-1" title="What are the prerequisites?">
    Valid Emirates ID and registered UAE PASS account.
  </ae-accordion-item>
  <ae-accordion-item value="item-2" title="How long does processing take?">
    Instant issuance for digital services.
  </ae-accordion-item>
</ae-accordion>
```

### 11. Checkbox & Radio & Toggle
- **Imports**: `CheckboxComponent`, `RadioComponent`, `RadioGroupComponent`, `ToggleComponent`
- **Usage**:
```html
<!-- Checkbox -->
<ae-checkbox [(ngModel)]="agreed" label="I agree to the Terms and Conditions"></ae-checkbox>

<!-- Radio Group -->
<ae-radio-group [(ngModel)]="plan" name="plan" label="Select Plan">
  <ae-radio value="basic" label="Basic"></ae-radio>
  <ae-radio value="premium" label="Premium"></ae-radio>
</ae-radio-group>

<!-- Toggle Switch -->
<ae-toggle [(ngModel)]="notifications" label="Enable SMS Notifications"></ae-toggle>
```

### 12. Dropdown (`ae-dropdown`)
- **Import**: `import { DropdownComponent, DropdownGroupData } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `groups`: `DropdownGroupData[]`
  - `header`: `string`
  - `align`: `'start' | 'center' | 'end'`
  - `side`: `'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left'`
  - `triggerType`: `'click' | 'hover'`
- **Outputs**: `(select)`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-dropdown
  [groups]="[
    { items: [
      { label: 'Profile', value: 'profile', icon: 'user' },
      { label: 'Settings', value: 'settings', icon: 'gear' },
      { label: 'Logout', value: 'logout', icon: 'sign-out' }
    ]}
  ]"
  (select)="onSelect($event)">
  <ae-button slot="trigger" variant="outline">Options</ae-button>
</ae-dropdown>
```

### 13. Card (`ae-card`, `ae-card-header`, `ae-card-footer`)
- **Import**: `import { CardComponent, CardHeaderComponent, CardFooterComponent } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs on `ae-card`**:
  - `variant`: `'default' | 'flat' | 'outline' | 'bordered'`
  - `elevation`: `'none' | 'sm' | 'base' | 'md' | 'lg'`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-card variant="bordered" elevation="sm">
  <ae-card-header title="Service Overview" subtitle="Updated today"></ae-card-header>
  <p class="text-gray-700">Detailed information about the selected government service.</p>
  <ae-card-footer>
    <ae-button color="primary" size="sm">Apply Now</ae-button>
  </ae-card-footer>
</ae-card>
```

### 14. Breadcrumbs (`ae-breadcrumbs`)
- **Import**: `import { BreadcrumbsComponent, BreadcrumbItem } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**: `items: BreadcrumbItem[]` (`{ label: string, href?: string, current?: boolean }`)
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-breadcrumbs [items]="[
  { label: 'Home', href: '/' },
  { label: 'Services', href: '/services' },
  { label: 'Residency', current: true }
]"></ae-breadcrumbs>
```

### 15. Pagination (`ae-pagination`)
- **Import**: `import { PaginationComponent } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `total`: `number` (total items)
  - `pageSize`: `number` (items per page, default: `10`)
  - `currentPage`: `number` (1-indexed)
- **Outputs**: `(pageChange)`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-pagination
  [total]="100"
  [pageSize]="10"
  [currentPage]="page"
  (pageChange)="page = $event">
</ae-pagination>
```

### 16. Steps (`ae-steps`)
- **Import**: `import { StepsComponent, StepItem } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `steps`: `StepItem[]` (`{ title: string, description?: string, icon?: IconName }`)
  - `currentStep`: `number` (0-indexed or 1-indexed)
  - `direction`: `'horizontal' | 'vertical'`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-steps
  [currentStep]="1"
  [steps]="[
    { title: 'Identity Verification' },
    { title: 'Application Form' },
    { title: 'Payment & Confirmation' }
  ]">
</ae-steps>
```

### 17. Tooltip (`ae-tooltip`, `[aeTooltip]`) & Popover (`ae-popover`)
- **Imports**: `TooltipComponent`, `TooltipDirective`, `PopoverComponent`
- **Usage**:
```html
<!-- Tooltip directive -->
<ae-button aeTooltip="Click to download your permit" tooltipPosition="top">Download</ae-button>

<!-- Popover -->
<ae-popover position="bottom">
  <ae-button slot="trigger">View Details</ae-button>
  <div class="p-3 text-sm">Detailed popover content...</div>
</ae-popover>
```

### 18. File Upload (`ae-file-upload`)
- **Import**: `import { FileUploadComponent } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**: `label`, `accept`, `multiple`, `maxSize`, `helperText`, `error`
- **Outputs**: `(filesChange)`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-file-upload
  label="Upload Passport Copy"
  accept=".pdf,.jpg,.png"
  helperText="PDF or Image up to 5MB"
  (filesChange)="onFilesSelected($event)">
</ae-file-upload>
```

### 19. Range Slider (`ae-range-slider`)
- **Import**: `import { RangeSliderComponent } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**: `min`, `max`, `step`, `label`, `value`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-range-slider
  label="Investment Amount (AED)"
  [min]="1000"
  [max]="100000"
  [step]="500"
  [(ngModel)]="amount">
</ae-range-slider>
```

### 20. Avatar (`ae-avatar`), Banner (`ae-banner`), Blockquote (`ae-blockquote`), Hyperlink (`ae-hyperlink`), Navigation (`ae-navigation`)
- **Imports**: `AvatarComponent`, `BannerComponent`, `BlockquoteComponent`, `HyperlinkComponent`, `NavigationComponent`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-avatar src="/avatar.jpg" alt="User" size="lg" status="online"></ae-avatar>
<ae-banner variant="warning" title="System Maintenance">Scheduled on Saturday at 2 AM.</ae-banner>
<ae-blockquote author="Founding Father" tone="soft">Quote content here...</ae-blockquote>
<ae-hyperlink href="https://u.ae" external="true">Visit Official Portal</ae-hyperlink>
```

---

## Best Practices for AI Code Generation

1. **Always use standalone imports**: Never attempt to import an `NgModule` (e.g. do NOT do `AegovModule`). Import the exact component class needed (e.g. `[ButtonComponent, InputComponent]`).
2. **Always include the Tailwind CSS import**: Global styles must contain `@import "aegov-dls-angular/styles/tailwind.css";`.
3. **Use Phosphor Icon names**: Use valid icon names for `leftIcon`, `rightIcon`, or `<ae-icon name="...">` (e.g. `'check'`, `'x'`, `'arrow-right'`, `'gear'`, `'magnifying-glass'`, `'eye'`, `'eye-slash'`, `'user'`).
4. **Use exact button color literal types**: `color="primary"` or `color="secondary"`. Variant types: `variant="solid" | "soft" | "link" | "outline" | "outline-solid"`.
5. **Form components implement ControlValueAccessor**: Use `[(ngModel)]` or `[formControl]` directly with `<ae-input>`, `<ae-textarea>`, `<ae-select>`, `<ae-checkbox>`, `<ae-radio-group>`, `<ae-toggle>`, `<ae-range-slider>`.
